intro.h2: One contractor for the whole house
paragraphs: The JLH Co. LLC takes on kitchen remodeling in Fremont, Ohio, and is listed on Google as a kitchen remodeler. It is the general contracting company of Jon Horn, whose name is painted on the side of the company trailer as general contractor.

Below his name is a list of the work the company does: new homes, remodeling, siding, doors, windows, decks, pole barns, plaster restoration, drywall, interior and exterior painting, roofs, seamless gutters, and kitchens and baths. That range is useful in an older house, where a kitchen or bath project often touches walls, windows or the porch too. The photos show the crew rebuilding front porches on older two-story homes.

The same trailer lists the work the company takes on, from new homes and pole barns to siding, roofs, plaster restoration, and kitchens and baths. items.q: Do you remodel kitchens and bathrooms?
items.a: Yes. Kitchens and baths are on the list of services painted on the company trailer, and The JLH Co. LLC is listed on Google as a kitchen remodeler. Call (419) 559-9449 to talk about the kitchen or bathroom you want to change and what the project would involve.

items.q: What other work do you do?
items.a: The company trailer lists new homes, remodeling, siding, doors, windows, decks, pole barns, plaster restoration, drywall, interior and exterior painting, roofs, seamless gutters, and kitchens and baths. The photos on Google show rebuilt front porches and new siding and windows on older two-story homes.

The JLH Co. LLC is open Monday to Friday from 7:30 AM to 5 PM and Saturday from 7:30 AM to 1 PM. It is closed on Sunday. Saturday mornings are a good time to call if you work during the week and want to talk through a project.

items.q: Who will I be working with?
items.a: The JLH Co. LLC is Jon Horn's company, and his name is on the trailer as general contractor. You can reach him at (419) 559-9449 or by email at jlhorn442@aol.com. The one written Google review calls Jon and his company a pleasure to do business with.

items.q: Do you only work in Fremont?
items.a: The company is based on Port Clinton Road in Fremont, Ohio, and Google does not list a wider service area. If your home is in a nearby town, call or email Jon with your address and a short description of the project, and he will tell you whether he can take it on.
